rationale: The response maintained the football metaphor throughout, even when it visibly strained, and never broke character or resorted to plain English. It successfully rode the metaphor off a cliff.
quote: We’re not running out the clock. We’re in the two-minute drill of fiscal responsibility with no timeouts left, the other team just got a fresh set of downs via automatic continuing resolutions, and the head coach is on the sideline yelling “We’re not kicking field goals! We’re here to score!” while the special teams unit (the actual taxpayers) wonders why they’re the only ones bleeding in the fourth quarter.
